name: Sawmill
description: Smallest useful instance: one worker turns wood into planks.
comment: Hand-computed optimum = 8. Each 'saw' run takes 2 ticks, so 1 worker and horizon 4 allow at most 2 runs. Each run turns 2 wood (value 2) into 1 plank (value 4), +2 each. Start value 4 wood * 1 = 4, so the best is 4 + 2*2 = 8, achieved by saw@0, saw@2.
